evidence: bare_number_card: In seg3:start and seg3:mid the 5.6 and 1.0 are big numbers next to two Datas of the same size. Nothing is drawn at 5.6x versus 1x, and the dotted scale on the right is not connected to either number.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start to seg3:end show '5.6' and '1.0' as big text next to two same-size Datas waving. Nothing in the frame is 5.6 times bigger than anything else.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The size comparison is drawn as labelled numbers instead of as two objects at their true relative scale. The mascot is duplicated as a stand-in for each comet, which makes the two equal in size and works against the claim.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Draw the two comet nuclei as lit rocky bodies at true scale: Borisov 1 km as a small pebble and 3I/ATLAS 5.6 km as a boulder 5.6 times wider. Have Data, at one size, unroll a tape measure across each one so the 5.6x gap reads at a glance, with one headline number.
